test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some flutes are violins.

Some violins are tablas.

All tablas are sitars.

Conclusions:

(I) Some violins are sitars.

(II) Some flutes are tablas.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/575f26154eb8fa6b83fec470ccb333dba921f1aeb8f50aa7fd2ca5f3b2f5a322.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some violins are sitars → **True **(As, Some violins are tablas, All tablas are sitars. so, Some violins are sitars holds true)

(II) Some flutes are tablas → False (As, there is no direct relation between them)

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
